description: Restore the configured tenant or destination path from a dump under profile.dumpHostPath, with optional post-restore scheme describe and bounded count-query verification. Use after bootstrap or rebuild when the target tenant is ready; without confirm=true this returns the restore plan and does not write data.

configPath.description: Absolute path to an explicit local-ydb config file. Missing, unreadable, oversized, or invalid explicit files fail closed instead of using defaults.

confirm.description: Must be true to restore the tenant from the selected dump. Omit or false for plan-only output.

countQueries.description: Optional bounded whole-table SELECT COUNT(*) or COUNT(1) queries to verify restored data after the restore command.

label.description: Optional label used in verification output for this count query.

query.description: Bounded whole-table count query to run after restore, for example SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `tenant-relative/path`;. Must be a single statement using COUNT(*) or COUNT(1) and at most 4096 UTF-8 bytes.

describePaths.description: Optional tenant-relative paths to verify with scheme describe after the restore command.

path.description: Destination directory path for YDB tools restore -p, relative to the configured tenant. Defaults to . for tenant root.

profile.description: Named profile from local-ydb.config.json. Defaults to config.defaultProfile.

name: local_ydb_restore_tenant
